extracted.intended_audience: industrialists, factory managers, entrepreneurs, and business leaders
extracted.subtask_description: Practical managerial and organizational guidance for founding, running, staffing, and integrating iron/steel manufacturing works, including partnership formation, promotion, accounting, procurement, and personal leadership practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote those who render exceptional service
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no way of making a business successful that can vie with the policy of promoting those who render exceptional service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use internal promotion to reward and retain high performers (examples: William Borntraeger, William L. Abbott, Mr. Curry). Promoting from within produces leaders who understand the works and contributes materially to success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single chain of command — avoid dual authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon no account could two men be in the same works with equal authority. An army with two commanders-in-chief, a ship with two captains, could not fare more disastrously than a manufacturing concern with two men in command upon the same ground.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When organizing departments, assign one person as captain for a works so all report through a single line. Example: decision to make Mr. Jones sole captain resolved potential conflict and produced success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appoint people with appropriate manufacturing knowledge
rubrics_metrics.description: It was unjust to expect [an auditor], or any other office man, to be able to step into manufacturing and be successful from the start. He had neither the knowledge nor the training for this new work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid moving office/accounting staff into manufacturing leadership without training/experience. Select managers whose skills match the operational demands.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rigorous accounting and internal checking
rubrics_metrics.description: There is nothing more profitable than clerks to check up each transfer of material from one department to another in process of manufacture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implement precise accounting systems and clerical checks for transfers and in-process material; accurate accounts enabled knowing exact profit margins (example: first month's profit of $11,000 and the exact accounting of it).

rubrics_metrics.name: Own raw materials and finish the completed article (vertical integration)
rubrics_metrics.description: The one vital lesson in iron and steel that I learned in Britain was the necessity for owning raw materials and finishing the completed article ready for its purpose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Secure supply chains by acquiring or controlling raw-material sources and finishing capacities (example: erecting blast furnaces to avoid uncertainty in pig iron supply).

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid purchases of inferior plants; perform due diligence
rubrics_metrics.description: There is nothing so unsatisfactory as purchases of inferior plants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be cautious when acquiring used or inferior plants; assess suitability and total cost (example: reconstructed Escanaba furnace cost as much as new and underperformed). Do thorough inspection and evaluation prior to purchase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Experiment to produce essential inputs domestically
rubrics_metrics.description: With the ores within reach we could make ferro-manganese in our small furnace. The experiment was worth trying and the result was a great success.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Innovate to produce previously imported or expensive inputs (example: producing spiegel and ferro-manganese domestically reduced dependence on foreign suppliers and lowered prices from $80 to $50/ton). Encourage technical experimentation when resource access suggests feasibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigate mineral assets thoroughly before acquisition
rubrics_metrics.description: A high price was paid to them for their interests, and (with one of them, Mr. Davis, a very able young man) we became the owners, but not until a thorough investigation of the mine had proved that there was enough of manganese ore in sight to repay us.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conduct thorough geological/resource investigations and confirm reserves/projections before paying high prices for mines or resource properties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structure partner interests payable only from profits
rubrics_metrics.description: We always provided that the cost of the interest given was payable only out of profits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When granting partnership interests to employees or associates, structure the financial obligation so payment is deferred and contingent on profits to limit immediate capital burden.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailor compensation to individual preferences (salary vs. partnership)
rubrics_metrics.description: No... I don't want to have my thoughts running on business. I have enough trouble looking after these works. Just give me a h--l of a salary if you think I'm worth it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize that some valuable managers prefer salary/operational focus over equity. Offer compensation packages (high salary instead of partner interest) aligned with personal inclinations to retain talent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select managers for demonstrated character and practical ability
rubrics_metrics.description: We soon saw that he was a character... Much of the success of the Edgar Thomson Works belongs to this man.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recruit and promote individuals who demonstrate zeal, industry, and practical familiarity with the works (example: Captain Jones discovered as a two-dollar-a-day mechanic who became an outstanding manager). Prioritize observed on-the-job performance and character.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proactive sales strategy — secure orders before competitors notice
rubrics_metrics.description: We sent our agent through the country with instructions to take orders at the best prices he could obtain; and before our competitors knew it, we had obtained a large number--quite sufficient to justify us in making a start.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use aggressive market outreach and order-taking to establish demand and secure contracts early, even at favorable pricing, to underpin production start-up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public speaking: be natural and speak as to fellow humans
rubrics_metrics.description: When you stand up before an audience reflect that there are before you only men and women. You should speak to them as you speak to other men and women in daily intercourse... 'Avoid elocutionists like snakes,' he said, 'and be yourself.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When addressing audiences, avoid artificial elocution or performance; be your genuine self and speak plainly as in daily conversation. Advice attributed to Colonel Ingersoll.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel and intellectual study broaden perspective and ethical judgment
rubrics_metrics.description: All other travel compared to [a world voyage] seems incomplete... The result of my journey was to bring a certain mental peace... I began to view the various phases of human life from the standpoint of the evolutionist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage leaders to travel and study other cultures and religions to gain broader perspective, philosophical balance, and humane understanding that can inform judgment and philanthropy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treat government officials courteously; manage relations diplomatically
rubrics_metrics.description: We tried to get William to realize the importance of pleasing a government official... 'Vell, Captain, I hope you vas all right dis morning. I haf noting against you, Captain,' holding out his hand, which the Captain finally took and all was well.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handle government inspectors and officials with courtesy and diplomacy; apologies and tactful behavior can resolve disputes and prevent escalation (anecdote of William's successful conciliatory apology).
